subject.title: fix(hooks): report agent startup admission failures

question: After the no-late-execution defect is repaired, should `/hooks/agent` redefine HTTP success as runner-entry admission and allow existing callers to wait up to 15 seconds?
rationale: Code review can settle cancellation correctness, but the public webhook acknowledgement latency and retry contract require explicit owner intent.

options.title: Adopt admission acknowledgement
options.body: Return success only after a cancellation-safe runner-entry boundary and document and prove the new 15-second response contract.

options.title: Keep queue acknowledgement
options.body: Retain immediate acceptance and expose startup failure through a separate durable status or callback channel.

recommendation.title: Adopt admission acknowledgement
recommendation.body: Return success only after a cancellation-safe runner-entry boundary and document and prove the new 15-second response contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged idempotency work and recent webhook implementation and documentation define the current external hook contract.
